report:
Reviewed the complete offset_reuse claim, all five ordinary implementation entries, both ordinary tests, and the explicit TODO test. The guarantee applies to edits outside the item that change only absolute placement: its relative CST and typed content remain equal, and semantic queries that do not read coordinates must remain reusable. Coordinate-dependent diagnostics and position lookup are expressly allowed to change; this is not a requirement to keep those observations unchanged.

Implementation: span.rs represents RelativeSpan as an equality-comparable start/end pair without a source or absolute origin. parse/util.rs subtracts the same item base from each endpoint. parse/items.rs supplies item_start for top-level functions and the child's own start for associated functions/types/constants, keeping parent-relative placement separate. Its function CST construction passes that base into signature/body parsing and stores only relative ranges. associated.rs locates associated items by kind/name/occurrence, copies the selected child's CST into its own stash, and resolves placement into a separate absolute span. fns.rs keeps cst and span as independently tracked fields, with name/scope/owner identity. Signature and body queries read CST and semantic dependencies rather than self.span; body construction consumes relative CST spans. Together these boundaries allow placement updates while retaining equal semantic inputs and memoized results. Added essential associations for these parser and lowering/query-boundary files so future changes invalidate this review.

Tests: moving_associated_item_reuses_method_signature_and_body exercises both trait and impl owners. It forces the target body, asserts empty diagnostics, checks a warm request has no query executions, inserts a differently named sibling immediately before target, then compares the complete sorted execution trace. Expected traces permit owner items/signatures and keyed item construction to run but exclude target function signature/body execution. The captured Database event handler logs WillExecute and take_query_log drains it, so these are actual execution assertions rather than query-name comments. Regressions that leak placement into target CST or force target semantic consumers would add executions and fail the snapshots. The derive test inserts a newline outside a derived struct and asserts the generated source ID remains equal while origin.start changes. It establishes that placement observations can update independently of identity; it does not establish full generated semantic equality or downstream reuse. setup_root_module rebuilds parsed items from the edited source, and the captured builtin fixture provides Clone derive resolution.

The TODO types_spans_offset_reuse remains justified and explicitly deferred: comprehensive plain/generated insertion/removal scenarios comparing resolved positions, semantic values and downstream query reuse still require extending the existing edit-test fixtures with those observations. Neither the empty TODO body nor the derive identity-only test is credited as those checks. In particular explicit CST/value comparisons, removal cases and full generated-consumer reuse remain covered by that stated testing deferral; the associated-method execution test supplies substantive partial coverage today. No implementation evidence was reclassified as TODO and no missing implementation was disguised as a test deferral.

Executed cargo fmt, cargo build (passed with existing warnings), and cargo test -p sage-test-harness moving_ --lib: three tests passed, including both tests associated with this anchor. The third test was incidental to the filter and is not used to replace this anchor's declared test set. This review was restarted after the four association additions and fresh inputs were inspected. Source inspection and the stated partial test coverage support accepting the current evidence with its existing visible TODO, not claiming exhaustive tested coverage. Centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks remain the coordinator's separate completion obligation. Final refresh also inspected relative_composition association comments added concurrently in associated.rs, parse/items.rs and parse/util.rs; these change evidence metadata only and leave the assessed behavior and tests unchanged. Recaptured current helper dependencies before recording.
